jobs.title: Director of FP&A
jobs.description:
Senior FP&A leadership opportunity with a large, well-established North American manufacturing and distribution company headquartered in Vancouver. Excellent opportunity for an experienced finance leader who enjoys combining strategic financial oversight with hands-on analysis, developing high-performing teams, and influencing executive-level decision-making. Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a collaborative corporate culture.

Who- the Company:

Our client is a very well-established and successful manufacturing and distribution company with operations across North America, 2000 employees, 10+ legal entities, 30+ operating sites across Canada and the US, etc. They have a great reputation among their happy customers and partners. The 40+ person finance team is collaborative and friendly, and the leaders promote productive workdays with plenty of communication and organization to limit unnecessary overtime.

The company is recognized for its commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and professional development. Its finance team works collaboratively with senior leadership and business stakeholders to support organizational performance and long-term growth.

What- the Role:

Our client seeking a new Director of Financial Planning & Analysis
to lead its enterprise-wide FP&A function. Reporting to the Vice President of Strategy, this is a hands-on leadership position responsible for overseeing financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis across a large and complex North American organization.
The Director will lead and develop the FP&A team while partnering closely with the VP, CFO, executive leadership, Finance Business Partners, and other cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen financial planning discipline, improve forecasting accuracy, and deliver meaningful financial insights that support business decisions.

Key Responsibilities include:

Budgeting & Forecasting:
Lead enterprise-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning, including cash flow forecasting.
Financial Analysis & Reporting:
Oversee financial consolidation, performance analysis, and executive and Board reporting, identifying key business drivers, risks, and opportunities.
Financial Modelling & Capital Planning:
Lead scenario analysis, capital investment evaluations, and business case development to support strategic decision-making.
Business Partnership:
Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate performance, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable financial insights.
Process Improvement & Team Leadership:
Enhance FP&A processes, reporting standards, and forecasting accuracy while leading and developing a high-performing team.

SWIM will provide interested candidates with a detailed job description.

Who- the Candidate:

We are seeking a well-rounded senior-level FP&A professional with at least 10-15 years’ of progressive work experience, including around 5 years in people management. Canadian CPA designation and/or CFE will be viewed very favourably, as would MBA-Finance from a reputable University.
Qualified candidates will bring extensive experience leading financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, and management reporting functions, ideally within a large, complex, multi-site organization operating across Canada and the United States, and/or globally… i.e. $500M+ in revenues, 1000+ employees, and/or operations across multiple countries.
Experience within manufacturing, distribution, or other inventory-intensive industries
would be particularly relevant, given the organization's operational scale and complexity.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

Proven experience leading enterprise-wide budgeting and forecasting processes, including cash flow forecasting, and improving financial planning accuracy and discipline.
Strong financial modelling capabilities, including long-range planning, scenario analysis, capital investment evaluations, and business case development.
Experience consolidating financial information across multiple business units, regions, and operating entities.
Confidence presenting financial insights and recommendations to senior executives and influencing strategic business decisions.
A demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop finance professionals while remaining comfortable working hands-on with complex financial analysis.
Strong proficiency with financial systems, including SAP or comparable ERP platforms, and enterprise planning, reporting, and performance management tools. Experience with OneStream, Tableau, or similar platforms is an asset.
Beyond technical expertise, the ideal candidate is analytical and a collaborative leader, with strong business acumen
who can balance enterprise-level strategic thinking with attention to financial detail. Strong communication, business judgment, critical thinking, and the ability to constructively challenge assumptions are essential.
We are seeking someone who can build credibility with senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, drive continuous improvement, and develop a strong, accountable FP&A team.

How Much:

Competitive base salary commensurate with level of skills, experience, and education, likely in the range of $170,000 to $190,000, possibly with some upwards flexibility for highly qualified candidates who have many/most of the “nice to haves.” The company will provide their new Director of FP&A with a solid overall compensation package, including a generous variable compensation program, professional development support, and excellent health, dental, & vision benefits.

Where:

Corporate office in the heart of downtown Vancouver, working from office 4-5 days/week to allow for plenty of in-person relationship building, presentations/meetings, and collaboration. It is anticipated that there will be around 5% business travel in this role (within Canada and US).

SWIM Recruiting will be conducting initial interviews and presenting shortlisted candidates directly to the hiring team.
If you already have a Recruiter at SWIM, please reach out to them directly. If you do not yet have a contact at SWIM Recruiting, please click ‘APPLY’

Analytical rigor

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.

jobs.description:
Head of Revenue - Full-time, Remote

Application Deadline: November 29th, 2026 @ 11:59pm EST

Build the revenue engine that takes BeMo to the next stage of growth.

Why BeMo?

At BeMo, our mission is rooted in the belief that education is a universal right, not a privilege. We help students pursue highly competitive professional programs through admissions consulting, test preparation, and technology-enabled services. Our team is remote, fast-moving, data-driven, and focused on measurable student and business outcomes.

The Role:

We are looking for a commercially rigorous Head of Revenue to own the full revenue system across demand generation, sales, expansion, lifecycle revenue, and revenue operations. This is not a traditional sales-leadership role. Your job is to identify the biggest constraint on profitable growth, quantify the opportunity, prioritize the highest-leverage initiatives, and lead cross-functional execution.

You will be accountable for increasing cash and revenue while protecting the quality and economics of growth. You will work directly with the CEO and lead the revenue organization toward BeMo's long-term growth trajectory.

What You Will Own:

Company-wide revenue growth across marketing, sales, direct/self-serve revenue, upsells, cross-sells, downsells, saves, referrals, and reactivation.
Demand generation economics, including qualified lead volume, cost per qualified request, CAC, ROI/ROAS, and channel-level growth efficiency.
Sales performance, including completed consultations, revenue per completed call, conversion rate, AOV, show efficiency, response speed, and forecasting accuracy.
Pricing, packaging, offers, promotions, and lifecycle monetization designed to increase customer value without relying on short-term pull-forward tactics.
Revenue operations: attribution, dashboards, lead tracking, funnel measurement, forecasting, QA, and reliable experiment measurement.
A disciplined testing program across acquisition, landing pages, sales, follow-up, email/SMS/direct mail, offers, and expansion revenue.
Cross-functional prioritization: decide where the next dollar and the next hour of team capacity create the highest expected incremental value.
Revenue leadership systems that reduce dependence on any single individual and create repeatable, scalable execution.

How Success Will Be Measured:

The role carries a significant performance-based component aligned with the same outcomes the role controls. Performance is evaluated across three dimensions:
Cash growth: durable improvement in actual cash received.
Demand generation: growth in qualified demand and channel economics, not traffic or lead volume in isolation.
Strategic execution: completion and quality of the systems, experiments, reporting, automation, and longer-term initiatives required to compound revenue growth.

These outcomes are also subject to a company growth-driver score that prevents one strong metric from masking deterioration elsewhere in the revenue system. The objective is sustainable progress toward BeMo's long-term growth trajectory, not local optimization of one department.

What You Will Do:

Diagnose the revenue funnel and identify the highest-value constraint before prescribing solutions.
Build quarterly revenue plans with quantified assumptions, targets, owners, timelines, and expected impact.
Lead the Sales Manager and coordinate tightly with marketing, operations, support, finance, and DevOps.
Set and monitor leading and lagging KPIs across acquisition, sales, and expansion revenue.
Design and review experiments with defined hypotheses, controls, success metrics, guardrails, and decision rules.
Improve the economics of paid and organic acquisition while maintaining sufficient qualified demand for the sales organization.
Increase revenue per lead and revenue per customer through better conversion, AOV, offers, upsells, cross-sells, and reactivation.
Build accurate forecasting, attribution, and executive reporting so decisions are based on trusted data.
Use AI and automation where they improve speed, conversion, decision quality, or operating leverage.
Develop leaders, delegate execution appropriately, and hold teams accountable for both results and quality.

We’d Love to Hear From You if You…

Have 7+ years of progressively senior revenue, growth, commercial, sales, or marketing leadership experience.
Can demonstrate material revenue growth you personally helped cause, with baseline, endpoint, time period, and measurable contribution.
Have owned more than one part of the revenue system - ideally demand generation plus sales, lifecycle/expansion, or RevOps.
Are highly quantitative and can translate funnel changes into incremental revenue, cash, CAC, and contribution economics.
Have managed leaders and teams rather than relying on personal heroics.
Can distinguish correlation from causation and are comfortable changing your view when the data contradicts your initial hypothesis.
Know how to prioritize aggressively and can explain what should not be done yet.
Have strong attention to detail, forecasting discipline, and operating cadence.
Are comfortable in a remote, high-accountability environment and can work across functions without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Compensation & Location:

Remote role. Potential total annual compensation up to $300,000+ CAD, including competitive base compensation and a significant performance based bonus tied to cash growth, demand generation, strategic execution, and progress against the company's long term revenue growth plan. Final compensation will depend on experience and performance.

Our Hiring Process:

Our hiring process includes multiple steps. You will progress to each step if we believe there's a good match for both parties. The process includes a review of your application, a skills assessment test, a virtual OR phone interview, a face-to-face interview with select members of our team via video conference and lastly, reference calls.

How to Apply:

Simple. Click "Apply" and fill out the short application form.

We won’t be able to individually respond to all applicants, but if we feel that you’re a strong match, we will be in touch via email to proceed with your application. Thanks, and we look forward to hearing from you!

This role is pivotal in establishing AI at scale by driving operational efficiency, reliability, and compliance throughout the entire model development lifecycle (from experimentation to production deployment). You will architect and build reusable platform capabilities, reference architectures, deployment patterns, and platform services that support both traditional machine learning and large language model use cases across multiple lines of business. Success will be measured by your ability to define and standardize technical activities, mature operational practices, and drive measurable business impact and stakeholder adoption. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise in MLOps, hands-on engineering leadership, and strong stakeholder engagement skills to deliver on a strategic vision for enterprise-scale AI operations.

How You’ll Succeed

Technical Leadership and Contribution - Translate strategic capability roadmaps into actionable technical deliverables, including the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines, end-to-end MLOps workflows, and automated ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, validation, and deployment. Oversee the development of enterprise-grade, production-ready, and standardized MLOps capabilities to support scalable and reliable AI delivery across the organization. Drive the creation of reusable frameworks, platform services, engineering standards, and deployment patterns that accelerate AI delivery while reducing operational complexity and duplication across teams.

Expertise with CI/CD, monitoring, model governance, and observability frameworks.

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Regional Sales Director for our Aspirational Big Bets (New Logo) Enterprise team. Regional Sales Directors have a critical role and responsibility to develop and manage a team of Account Executives (Sales reps) to help them meet and exceed individual and team goals and metrics. Your team will be focused predominantly on new-customer acquisition: identifying high-potential organizations, developing trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and leading complex sales from first conversation through close.

We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals. This is a high value opportunity with uncapped commission and a competitive salary.

Your Mission

The Regional Sales Director is responsible for developing and managing a productive team of Aspirational Big Bets Account Executives. You will demonstrate the ability to train, motivate, and coach the team to successfully deliver or exceed quota for your patch. You will also qualify sales opportunities, setting proper customer expectations and quarterbacking deal negotiations.

As a Regional Sales Director, You Will

Demonstrate a knowledgeable understanding of OneTrust’s products and services, and how the different offerings can be leveraged to address different sets of customer pain points
Manage, hire, and train a team of Account Executives, driving an inclusive team dynamic and high-performance team culture focused exclusively on acquiring new customers
Develop a leverageable understanding of customer needs to assist with prospecting and qualifying potential buyers
Develop and maintain robust pipelines for future business for yourself and your team, set and hold to commits and accurately forecast delivery against those pipelines
Engage with high priority accounts for OneTrust, identifying and driving strategic engagement with the buyer, adjusting your / your team’s approach based on buyer persona and company context and leveraging OneTrust leadership accordingly to support deal close
Partner consistently with collaborating organizations (e.g., Business Development, Specialist Sales, Solution Engineering, Partner Sales, Marketing) throughout the deal cycle to increase deal close rates and deliver a coordinated prospect experience
Track and report on metrics for your team, utilizing data and regular pipeline inspection to prioritize actions and surface risks early
In partnership with HR, support the leadership team in ensuring equitable experiences, strengthening inclusion acumen, and promoting a culture of inclusivity and belonging that embraces the contributions of all team members

You Are

You are someone who’s both a player and coach with a hunting mentality and consultative approach. You enjoy motivating and driving others to perform while still exceeding yourself. You approach problems with the utmost creativity and perspective, and are well-disciplined in sales processes and CRM hygiene.

Your Experience Includes

Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience
10+ of proven sales experience, ideally selling B2B Enterprise-level software or related technologies
5 years of people management experience
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions and work with partner ecosystems and cross-functional deal teams
Effective customer-facing communication skills and experience communicating with C-Level Executives effectively
Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers
A strong prospecting and pipeline-generation discipline, with the resilience and ownership to create opportunities rather than rely solely on inbound demand
Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias

Experience with Salesforce CRM

The Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance is accountable for setting and governing CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, As Managing Director, Technology Architecture & Governance, you will set and govern CPP Investments’ enterprise technology architecture, engineering practices and lifecycle standards, helping ensure the Fund operates on a resilient, modern and sustainable technology foundation.

Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Technology & Data, you will provide practical, outcome-focused direction on architecture, technical debt, technology lifecycle management and engineering excellence. This enterprise leadership role has no direct reports and operates through influence, deep technical expertise, sound judgement and effective governance.

The Team

Technology & Data helps enable CPP Investments’ investment strategies and supports the Fund’s day-to-day operations through enterprise technology and data capabilities. Within the department, the Technology Architecture & Governance mandate provides enterprise-wide direction for architecture, engineering practices and technology lifecycle management, partnering across the Fund to strengthen resilience, scalability, cost efficiency and delivery effectiveness.

Accountabilities

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Regional Sales Director for our Aspirational Big Bets (New Logo) Enterprise team. Regional Sales Directors have a critical role and responsibility to develop and manage a team of Account Executives (Sales reps) to help them meet and exceed individual and team goals and metrics. Your team will be focused predominantly on new-customer acquisition: identifying high-potential organizations, developing trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and leading complex sales from first conversation through close.

We invest heavily in our Sales Team through demand generation, methodology-driven sales philosophy, weekly sales trainings, customer-driven roadmaps, and a readily-available executive team to help close deals. This is a high value opportunity with uncapped commission and a competitive salary.

Your Mission

The Regional Sales Director is responsible for developing and managing a productive team of Aspirational Big Bets Account Executives. You will demonstrate the ability to train, motivate, and coach the team to successfully deliver or exceed quota for your patch. You will also qualify sales opportunities, setting proper customer expectations and quarterbacking deal negotiations.

As a Regional Sales Director, You Will

Demonstrate a knowledgeable understanding of OneTrust’s products and services, and how the different offerings can be leveraged to address different sets of customer pain points
Manage, hire, and train a team of Account Executives, driving an inclusive team dynamic and high-performance team culture focused exclusively on acquiring new customers
Develop a leverageable understanding of customer needs to assist with prospecting and qualifying potential buyers
Develop and maintain robust pipelines for future business for yourself and your team, set and hold to commits and accurately forecast delivery against those pipelines
Engage with high priority accounts for OneTrust, identifying and driving strategic engagement with the buyer, adjusting your / your team’s approach based on buyer persona and company context and leveraging OneTrust leadership accordingly to support deal close
Partner consistently with collaborating organizations (e.g., Business Development, Specialist Sales, Solution Engineering, Partner Sales, Marketing) throughout the deal cycle to increase deal close rates and deliver a coordinated prospect experience
Track and report on metrics for your team, utilizing data and regular pipeline inspection to prioritize actions and surface risks early
In partnership with HR, support the leadership team in ensuring equitable experiences, strengthening inclusion acumen, and promoting a culture of inclusivity and belonging that embraces the contributions of all team members

You Are

You are someone who’s both a player and coach with a hunting mentality and consultative approach. You enjoy motivating and driving others to perform while still exceeding yourself. You approach problems with the utmost creativity and perspective, and are well-disciplined in sales processes and CRM hygiene.

Your Experience Includes

Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience
10+ of proven sales experience, ideally selling B2B Enterprise-level software or related technologies
5 years of people management experience
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions and work with partner ecosystems and cross-functional deal teams
Effective customer-facing communication skills and experience communicating with C-Level Executives effectively
Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles with multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers
A strong prospecting and pipeline-generation discipline, with the resilience and ownership to create opportunities rather than rely solely on inbound demand
Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias

Extra Awesome

Experience with Salesforce CRM
Experience selling into privacy, security, governance, risk, compliance, or other trust-related business areas

For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Nevada, New York, Rhode Island, and Washington-based candidates: the annual base pay range for this role is listed below. Within this range, individual pay is determined by several factors, including location, job-related skills, work experience, and relevant education and/or training. This role may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, equity, and/or commissions, as well as benefits.

Salary Range

$153,750—$205,000 USD

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Reporting to the Managing Director, Head of Technology & Data, you will provide practical, outcome-focused direction on architecture, technical debt, technology lifecycle management and engineering excellence. Within the department, the Technology Architecture & Governance mandate provides enterprise-wide direction for architecture, engineering practices and technology lifecycle management, partnering across the Fund to strengthen resilience, scalability, cost efficiency and delivery effectiveness.

Drive continuous improvement in how technology is designed, built, tested, and released, enabling predictable delivery, higher quality outcomes, and faster time to value

What You Bring

Deep expertise in engineering, enterprise architecture, modern technology platforms, and large-scale system design

Understanding of financial services or large, complex enterprises and their regulatory and risk environments
